scenes.text: This is ZiBrand, and every hoodie I want says the same thing: coming soon.
You can't order yet, and refreshing the page all day isn't a plan. Drops sell fast.
So I built a bot to do the watching for me.
Every five minutes, a free cloud job reads the store's live feed, checks if a hoodie just went live, and if it did, it messages me.
Making the bot takes five quick steps in Telegram's BotFather: new bot, a name, a username, grab the token, and get your chat I D.
The logic is about eighty lines of Python plus one workflow file: spot the available flip, send a Telegram message, and run it on a schedule.
Push it to a public repo, add two secrets, and it runs itself. Free, and silent until something actually drops.
Now the drop finds me. No refreshing, no fear of missing out. Just a ping, and I'm first in line.
It's open source. Build your own.
